title: Wartburg - Wikipedia
content: # Wartburg. The **Wartburg** (German pronunciation: ) is a castle originally built in the Middle Ages. It is situated on a precipice of 410 metres (1,350 ft) to the southwest of and overlooking the town of Eisenach, in the state of Thuringia, Germany. It was the home of St. Elisabeth of Hungary, the place where Martin Luther translated the New Testament of the Bible into German, the site of the Wartburg festival of 1817 and the supposed setting for the possibly legendary *Sängerkrieg*. | Wartburg Castle is located in Thuringia Wartburg Castle  Wartburg Castle  Location within Thuringia Show map of Thuringia  Wartburg Castle is located in Germany Wartburg Castle  Wartburg Castle  Wartburg Castle (Germany) Show map of Germany | |. title: Wartburg Castle, Germany - tourist information from GermanSights
content: Wartburg Castle is one of the most significant buildings in German history with an almost mythological connection to various significant events which have shaped the country. "What a host of memories this name evokes for every German..." wrote the architect charged with the restoration of the building in the 19th century. Catalyst for the Protestant Reformation Martin Luther, poet and writer Johann Wolfgang von Goethe and the start of the push for the creation of Germany in the 19th century are all linked to the castle. Wartburg Castle is situated just outside the town of Eisenach in the German state of Thuringia. It is possible to walk up to Wartburg Castle from Eisenach or to take a public bus from the centre of the town. title: Wartburg Castle – UNESCO-Welterbestätten Deutschland e. V.
content: # Wartburg Castle. **Large, imposing and steeped in history: high above the town of Eisenach sits Wartburg Castle, a UNESCO World Heritage site since 1999. One of the best-preserved medieval German fortresses and almost 1,000 years old, it is possibly Germany’s most famous castle, and certainly one of its most important.**. Courtly art from the Middle Ages, St. Elisabeth’s life and work, the German student fraternities‘ festival, the contest of the minnesingers and Wagner’s romantic opera Tannhäuser – all these are an integral part of the Wartburg. At the Hotel auf der Wartburg and its restaurant you’ll enjoy a more comfortable stay than Luther in his spartan cell. ## Wartburg Castle Eisenach. Wartburg Castle is „an outstanding monument of the feudal epoch in Central Europe“. Wartburg Castle is also connected with the singers’ contest, the holy Elizabeth and the festival of student. Only the most outstanding testimonies to the history of mankind and nature are granted the World Heritage title by UNESCO.
